Hi Sarah,

Thanks for signing up and taking Redwood for a spin — I saw your submission and wanted to reach out to schedule a quick demo so we can walk through your use case and make sure we show the right parts of the product.

Before we lock a time, two quick qualification questions so I can tailor the demo:

- Volume: rough monthly token/requests estimate or number of users/apps that would hit the API?
- Timeline & priority: are you evaluating now for a POC in the next 1-3 months, or is this longer-term?
- Any security/compliance blockers (SOC 2, data residency) we should know about ahead of time?

Propose a 30-minute demo. I'm available:
- Wed 7/8 at 11:00 AM PDT
- Wed 7/8 at 3:00 PM PDT
- Thu 7/9 at 10:00 AM PDT

You can also pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/30min

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — excited to learn more. Answers inline:
- Use case: primary goal is runtime chat for our care coordination product (multi-turn assistant + summarization of clinical notes). We also plan to use embeddings for semantic search across patient notes.
- Volume: rough estimate is ~150k generated tokens/day initially; peak concurrency likely small (10-20 concurrent requests), but we expect growth over the next 6-12 months.
- Timeline: we'd like to run a POC in August and decide on a partner by September.
- Compliance: SOC 2 is required; data residency in the US preferred.

Would prefer Wed 7/8 at 3:00 PM PDT. Quick question — do you have any notes on pricing tiers for expected volume and info on SOC 2 compliance?
